rows.title: Dates, Polyunsaturated Fatty Acids, Dietary Fiber, and Probiotics as Potential Complementary Modulators of Gut Microbiota and Oxidative Stress: An Integrative Review.
rows.evidence_boundary: The integrative review combines distinct foods, nutrients, fibers, and probiotic evidence; ingredient-specific attribution is limited, and whole dates are explicitly not established as a prebiotic.

rows.title: Berberine induces pleiotropic beneficial effects via hormesis.
rows.evidence_boundary: Hormesis is used as an explanatory framework for broad berberine effects, much of which derives from preclinical evidence; clinically optimal exposure and long-term human outcomes remain uncertain.

rows.title: Effect of citicoline on cognitive function and functional recovery in patients with mild-to-moderate traumatic brain injury: a randomized placebo-controlled trial.
rows.evidence_boundary: This is a small single-center pilot RCT in mild-to-moderate TBI using 1000 mg/day citicoline; findings are population- and dose-specific and require larger replication.

rows.title: Common Supplements in Plant-Based Nutrition: Dosing, Formulations, and Safety.
rows.evidence_boundary: The article provides practical formulation, dosing, labeling, and safety guidance rather than a systematic efficacy assessment; examples should not be read as universal product recommendations.

rows.title: Omega-3 and Omega-6 Fatty Acids and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Diabetes - A Review of Current Evidence.
rows.evidence_boundary: Cardiovascular outcomes differ by fatty-acid formulation and dose; high-dose purified EPA findings do not transfer automatically to lower-dose mixed EPA+DHA products or omega-6 interventions.
